motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Panel slide, photo crossfade, and row arrival. Reduced motion removes the flyover and the count-up.

components.name: Score button
components.css: .ds-score { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; background: #F7FBF8; color: #0E6B4F; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-score:hover { background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-score:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D23B2E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: Compare and Shortlist on the green bar.
components.css: .ds-ghost { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; color: #F7FBF8; border: 1px solid rgba(247, 251, 248, 0.55); cursor: pointer; } .ds-ghost:hover { background: rgba(247, 251, 248, 0.12); } .ds-ghost[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #F7FBF8; color: #0E6B4F; } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D23B2E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Address field
components.css: .ds-field { height: 36px; border: 0; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1A1C19; padding: 0 10px; caret-color: #0E6B4F; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #3D4F47; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D23B2E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Column head
components.css: .ds-head { background: #0E6B4F; color: #F7FBF8; padding: 14px 16px; text-align: right; } .ds-figure { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 0.95; }

components.name: Header
components.description: Route-green bar with the wordmark and search.
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 10px 12px; background: #0E6B4F; color: #F7FBF8; } .ds-mark { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.northStar: A commuter timetable on a map
narrative.overview: The map is the task. The score is a timetable beside it: figures in columns, a not-covered row left in place and out of the average.
keyCharacteristics: Route green owns the header and the column heads
Vermilion only for the pin and the selected column

rules.name: One column of figures
rules.body: The overall number and each factor number share a right-aligned tabular column.

dos: Keep the address field the primary action
Show source, year, and status on every factor
donts: Don't replace a number with a progress ring
